sections.heading: Major Advisors
sections.text:
Major advisors work in the departments/programs and can assist students with specific questions regarding major and minor requirements.
Major advisors provide the following services:
Assist you with academic plans and course scheduling (choose courses for future quarters).
Connect you with opportunities that are unique to your major department.
Advise on requirements to declare a major, double major, or minor in their department.
Approve or deny your major requirements when you file to graduate.
Advise on minors offered through their department.

sections.heading: Major Advisors > Connect with Major Advising
